subject.title: Telegram forum: no reliable topic-name -> topic_id resolution for agent routing

question: Which Telegram agent-facing surface should own known forum topic-name to topic_id routing for this issue?
rationale: Current code has an observed id-to-name cache, but choosing reverse lookup behavior affects agent tool contracts, ambiguity handling, stale topic data, and message routing safety.

options.title: Add observed topic catalog/list action
options.body: Expose known forum topics as a Telegram-owned list/catalog action so agents can choose an id and handle duplicate or stale names explicitly.

options.title: Add direct name resolver
options.body: Provide a resolver that accepts a topic name and returns a single id only when unambiguous, with explicit errors for missing or duplicate names.

options.title: Keep current metadata-only model
options.body: Do not add routing by name and document that Telegram forum sends require numeric topic ids learned from current-topic context or user configuration.

recommendation.title: Add observed topic catalog/list action
recommendation.body: Expose known forum topics as a Telegram-owned list/catalog action so agents can choose an id and handle duplicate or stale names explicitly.

likelyOwner.reason: They have recent central history on Telegram topic cache persistence and action normalization, which are the likely implementation boundaries for this decision.
